name: 75248 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75248 (Dallas) has 185 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75248 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75248 (Dallas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75248 (Dallas) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
